name: X 媒体下载
summary: 输入 X 帖子链接，下载其中的全部图片和 MP4 视频。
author: Glance

commands.name: 下载媒体
commands.description: 输入一条 X（Twitter）帖子的链接，例如 https://x.com/用户名/status/123456，下载该帖子里的全部图片和 MP4 视频。仅支持公开帖子。

prompt.description: X 帖子链接或帖子 ID / X post URL or tweet ID.

privacy.notice: 帖子链接将发送至 X 公开接口（及其备用镜像 fxtwitter）用于解析媒体地址；不会上传你的任何文件。 / The post URL is sent to X's public API (and the fxtwitter mirror as fallback) to resolve media addresses; none of your files are uploaded.

en.name: X Media Download
en.summary: Paste an X post URL to download all its images and MP4 videos.

run.name: Download Media
run.description: Paste the URL of an X (Twitter) post, e.g. https://x.com/user/status/123456, to download every image and MP4 video it contains. Only public posts are supported.
